why_not_one_block_off: Both plates cover A-C (key maps; 15's letters are not printed, identity by column continuation 749/689/629 -> 750/690/630). Ave A is the 0/100 hundred-block break on both: sheet 13 block 749 fronts 30th St with 2 4 6 ... 24 and block 689 with 102 104 ... 124; sheet 15 block 750 fronts 30th/31st with 1 3 ... 23 and block 690 with 101 103 ... 123; '70'' printed in the roadway on both. One block east is Strand (Ave B), 80' (13: 1792/2043, 250 px) with the 100/200 break (689: 102-124, 629: 202-224); it is also drawn wider than 70'. Faces read off the native rasters at rows 2700-3500 (13) and 400-1200 (15); 13's 837/1050 agree with lattice.json, 15's lattice x chain (pitch 935, weak) is wrong and was not used.
